notes.title: Mad Factory is now AWARD WINNING!
notes.notes:
Hello Factory Employees

We are very pleased and thoroughly excited to announce that Mad Factory has won an award. 

We are the winner of the:
2018 Inaugural Infinity Film Festival Monolith Award for content, celebrating “Story Advanced by Technology!”

We also now display a lovely laurel on the store page. 

As you can imagine we're extremely happy to receive this award. We knew our game had this potential and it's fantastic to see others agree. 

Best

Mike, Andy and the Mad Factory Team

notes.title: BAFTA Selection
notes.notes:
Hello Factory Employees

The Third Floors Immersive team are very honoured to announce that Mad Factory was selected to be part of BAFTA's VR Showcase. 


"This year’s VR showcase has been selected by BAFTA’s Immersive Entertainment Advisory Group. The mission of the group, among other things, is to educate the leaders and members of BAFTA about VR/AR/MR/XR experiences, and showcase outstanding work that moves the needle in the medium (narrative / storytelling, games etc). 

The showcase is running across three dates at Digital Catapult: 2nd October, 9th October, 16th October."


It's a high accolade to be selected and brings a recognition to the game we feel it deserves. 

Keep fulfilling those orders!

Best

Mike, Andy and the Mad Factory Team

notes.title: Mad Factory Arcade Advertising
notes.notes:
Hello Factory Employees

We're seeing a fantastic adoption of Mad Factory by the Retail/ VR Arcade sector! This was absolutely our goal and this subsequently directed many of our design decisions. 

We have not just put the game out there and left it at that though. During a Pilot phase here in the UK, we formed some great, close relationships with Arcade owners and listened to how they market a title. 
We correspondingly created a broad range of digital marketing assets from banners to badges, for use in Arcades in their front of house or on their game selection systems.

These are available to all Arcade owners and we invite you to get in touch so we can: 
- Learn about you and your needs
- Provide you with the front of house marketing assets that work for you. 

Please contact us via madfactory@thethirdfloorinc.com

Operators are standing by!

Best

Mike, Andy and the Mad Factory crew...

notes.title: You've got orders to fill!
notes.notes:
Mad Factory is now released and is playable on both the Vive and the Oculus.

Every game is a labour of love for the team involved and this one is no exception. 

Mad Factory started as a short playable demo, something to show of the interaction technology our Immersive team had developed. But there was a seed of a compelling game within this and the response we saw from players at the numerous shows and events we demoed at, told us we had to develop this to a releasable product. So we did, and here it is. 

We're certain you'll have as much fun playing this as those who inspired us. 

Can you play the perfect game? 

Best

Mike, Andy and the Mad Factory team...

notes.title: Steam Launch Date and Oculus Support
notes.notes:
Hey Factory Employees

We have two important pieces of news today!

[b]Firstly[/b] our Steam launch date is now set in stone. 
It will be the 20th September, as in TOMORROW!

We've finally hit the point where this title can be released to the masses. It'll be on sale to the would be Factory workers AND will be available via a Steam Cybercafe license. 

Once you have the game we'd love to hear your thoughts in the review section, and if you like it, please tell a friend. 

[b]Secondly[/b] we can now announce that Oculus support is included!

We've ironed out the last issues and so from tomorrow the game will launch with both Vive and Oculus support.  


Phew! We're going to struggle to top this news. 

That's all for now so we hope you enjoy the game and spread the word. 

Best

Mike, Andy and the Mad Factory crew...

notes.title: Welcome To The Factory
notes.notes:
Hi everybody, 

Thanks for stopping by the Mad Factory :) 
We're a creative developer team working at The Third Floor and we're happy to (finally) say the factory is open for business...We hope you enjoy it. 

For Mad Factory, we aimed to have the gameplay be simple to get, but rewarding on replay - with a bunch of little tricks to discover to up your score. 

This burst of VR fun is set in a playful and visually rich world mostly because we had a great time coming up with the look and feel of robot chickens, waterfall milk machines and mechanical egg crackers! Have a look around. More from us soon... 

Best, Mike, Andy, and the Mad Factory crew...
